rules.single_machine: Every task type uses this state machine.
rules.gate_before_implementation: A standard-path task cannot enter implementing until Human Review Gate 1 approves the full Test SHA.
rules.reviewer_entry: Reviewer entry requires Tester PASS evidence on the exact candidate SHA.
rules.completion: Complete requires final human approval bound to the exact candidate SHA.
rules.rework: Production rework updates the implementation lane and deterministically regenerates candidate; prior candidate evidence is invalid.

order: current Agent platform built-in GitHub Connector
gh CLI only when the current platform has no built-in Connector
preflight: record host authentication separately from Agent sandbox or network reachability
complete external-tool checks before entering the loop
pre-authorize the smallest stable command prefixes practical
do not wait for chat approval during execution

rules: Test and implementation start independently from the same exact base SHA.
Each input has an independent checkout or worktree and independent commit.
Worker input excludes owner acceptance-test implementation.
Candidate is the deterministic integration of test and implementation revisions.
A child ticket is used only for an independent deliverable, not merely for a lane.
Tester and Reviewer use the same exact candidate revision and bind evidence to that SHA.
Rework updates the implementation lane, regenerates candidate, and invalidates prior candidate evidence.

iteration_limits.on_limit: Stop automatic looping and escalate for a human decision.

validation_execution_checkpoints.scope: Validation execution only; authoring, implementation, exploration, and review use task-specific handoff budgets.

roles.orchestrator: Classifies, creates independent lanes, controls transitions, integrates candidate revisions, and escalates limits.
roles.worker: Writes production in the implementation lane without owner acceptance-test implementation.
roles.tester: Writes only tests or evidence and never repairs production.
roles.reviewer: Starts only after Tester PASS, reviews without production fixes, and may write only an appended lessons-log entry.

initialization.first_clone: Interactive collection is allowed before lane creation.
initialization.derived_worktree: Reuse verified non-secret initialization inputs and local dependency cache through deterministic non-interactive hydration.
initialization.missing_or_invalid_input: Fail before lane creation; do not prompt inside a lane.

profile_separation.common_workflow: This contract and the agent-workflow Skill are reusable and platform-neutral.
profile_separation.repository_profile: AGENTS.md and role files add repository-specific domain, ownership, test, and evidence requirements without redefining this contract.
